method: Dedicated worker per library; ten warmups; 100 single-input samples; fixed repeated four-input batches. Timings cover native parsing (AST for gpu-time), excluding normalization, recurrence expansion, worker messaging and DOM. Initialization includes local development module loading. Different output contracts make this an experimental workload comparison, not an interchangeable-feature ranking.
